contentText: China urges ​calm and restraint on ​all sides, a spokesperson for its foreign ​ministry said ‌on Monday, ⁠when asked about US ‌President Donald Trump's threat to ⁠launch a naval blockade of the ​Strait of Hormuz ‌after talks with Iran failed. Keeping the key waterway ‌safe, stable and unimpeded ​serves the common interest of the international community, the spokesperson, ​Guo Jiakun, told ​a regular ​press conference. FRANCE 24's Yena Lee reports from Beijing, China.
